name: Luna
bio: This is little Luna, she is the sweetest little girl she was very scared at first and would hide and we didn’t think the shop was the right place for her, but now she is one of the most loving and playful cats I have you will find her on the scratching post or on someone’s knee wanting a cuddle, her favourite toy is the mouse with bells on.
photoAlt: Luna, a black cat with a white chest and paws (socks)
